resale_co.name: Municipal Certificate of Continuing Occupancy (Municipal CCO), Residential Sale of House
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Riverdale Zoning Officer (enforcement officer under Borough Code Chapter 82)
resale_co.lead_time: A minimum of 72 hours notice (not counting weekends and holidays) is required for the inspection.
requirements: Exterior zoning / property maintenance inspection: siding, trim and railings, gutters, glass and roof in good repair; sheds, pools, decks and fences meet zoning; driveway paved with asphalt; yard free of debris and overgrowth
Smoke and carbon monoxide detector certificate from the Fire Marshal (required for the Municipal CCO)
All open building, electrical, plumbing and fire permits closed before the CCO is issued
Seller provides a copy of the original survey and the buyer provides a copy of the new survey (not for condos or townhouses)
Seller's attorney name and phone required on the application
Any outstanding sewer connection fee balance paid in full; a sewer application is required if a sewer line is available to a home on private septic
Disclose abandoned wells, septic systems or fuel tanks, and any pools or hot tubs (pool barrier must meet state rules)

fees.label: Municipal CCO, per residential unit (Borough of Riverdale)
fees.quote: For any attached or detached single-family residential dwelling or residential dwelling not being located within a property containing four or more residential rental units ... a fee of $100 shall be charged.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the Application for Residential Municipal CCO and return it to the Zoning Official's office, 91 Newark Pompton Turnpike, with two checks payable to the Borough of Riverdale: $100 per residential unit for the exterior inspection and $45 for the Fire Marshal's smoke and carbon monoxide inspection. The Fire Marshal then calls to set up the interior inspection.

evidence.quote: No person shall convey title to any building unless, prior to the conveyance, the owner shall have obtained a continued certificate of occupancy.
The enforcement officer shall issue a certificate of continuing occupancy upon his or her inspection and satisfaction that no violations of the Borough of Riverdale Property Maintenance Code
The enforcement officer may waive the inspection and fee if any inspection of the same premises has been made within 60 days.
a fee of $100 shall be charged.
The fee for the Municipal CCO is $100.00 per residential unit.
A minimum 72 hours (not including weekends and holidays) notice is required.
All open building, electrical, plumbing, and fire permits must be closed before the issuance of this Municipal CCO
For CCO (Commercial & Residential) Zoning (for Riverdale Only).
Contact: Zoning Department, Stephanie Colella, 973-835-4060 ext. 6 or email scolella@riverdalenj.gov

resale_co.notes: Borough Code Chapter 82 (Ord. 2-2005, fees amended 2009/2010) requires a certificate of continuing occupancy before title to any building is conveyed; the fee is $100 for a one- or two-family home. The Borough's Municipal CCO - Residential Sale of House form (file dated May 2024) is a scanned document, so its text cannot be machine-checked; it confirms $100.00 per residential unit, 72 hours notice, and that the smoke/CO certificate from the Fire Marshal is required for the CCO. Building (construction) services are provided by Pompton Lakes under a shared service agreement (973-835-0143), but CCO zoning for Riverdale is handled by the Riverdale Zoning Department. No validity period is published; the code lets the officer waive a new inspection and fee if the premises was inspected within 60 days. Ordinance text was read through the ecode360 print view.

requirements: Smoke detectors installed in one- and two-family homes upon sale or change of occupancy, per N.J.A.C. 5:70
Carbon monoxide detectors in working order
All detectors working when the Fire Marshal arrives; a return inspection may need another inspection fee
Portable fire extinguisher (Borough Code 100-14 still names it in the certificate title; state law dropped it from the sale certificate in February 2025)

authorities.name: Riverdale Bureau of Fire Prevention (Fire Marshal), Borough of Riverdale
authorities.lead_time: After the CCO application is returned, the Fire Marshal calls to set up the interior inspection. The Fire Marshal is in the office Monday, Wednesday and Friday, 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

fees.label: Fire Marshal smoke and carbon monoxide detector inspection (with the Municipal CCO)
fees.quote: One for $45 for the Fire Marshall's Inspection Of the smoke and carbon monoxide detectors.

authorities.how_to_apply: Submit the $45 check (payable to Borough of Riverdale) with the Municipal CCO application to the Zoning Official's office; the Fire Marshal schedules the interior inspection. Code 100-14 says applications go to the Fire Official with the fee prepaid.
authorities.contact_title: Fire Official (from the NJ DCA fire directory)

evidence.quote: Prior to the sale, rental, transfer, lease or change of occupancy of any structure or part thereof, the owner shall first obtain from the Bureau of Fire Prevention a Certificate of smoke alarm, carbon monoxide alarm, and portable fire extinguisher compliance
The fee for the Certificate of smoke alarm, carbon monoxide alarm, and portable fire extinguisher compliance shall be in accordance with N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9 as amended.
One for $45 for the Fire Marshall's Inspection Of the smoke and carbon monoxide detectors.
CERTIFICATES OF COMPLIANCE FOR SMOKE DETECTORS AND CARBON MONOXIDE DETECTORS WILL BE ARRANGED THROUGH THE FIRE MARSHALL AND IS REQUIRED FOR THE MUNICIPAL CCO
The Fire Marshall is in his office on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 11:00AM to 1:00PM.
Riverdale Borough 1433 LEAID: 1433-001 Enf Auth. Municipal Fire Official Mark Lime Phone (973) 835-4060 Email fireprevention@riverdalenj.gov

fire_cert.notes: The smoke/CO certificate is arranged through the Fire Marshal as part of the Municipal CCO. The Borough's CCO form (scanned, May 2024) charges $45 for the Fire Marshal's inspection; Ord. 06-2022 (Code 100-14) ties the fee to the state schedule in N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9, so the fee may be tiered by days before closing; confirm. No Riverdale fire prevention web page was found; the Fire Official name, phone and e-mail come from the NJ DCA fire directory (survey 7/14/2026), and the LEA registry lists Riverdale as a municipal (M) enforcing agency. Code 100-14 still names the portable fire extinguisher, which P.L.2025, c.19 removed from the sale certificate in February 2025.

other_items.label: Surveys
other_items.detail: The seller must give a copy of the original survey and the buyer a copy of the new survey with the Municipal CCO application (not for condos or townhouses).

other_items.label: Sewer connection fee / sewer application
other_items.detail: Any outstanding balance on the Sewer Connection Fee must be paid in full; homes on private septic with a sewer line available on the street need a sewer application.

other_items.label: Abandoned wells, septic or fuel tanks
other_items.detail: The CCO application asks whether there are abandoned wells, septic systems or fuel tanks on the property.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: All open building, electrical, plumbing and fire permits must be closed before the Municipal CCO is issued (construction permits through the Pompton Lakes shared building department, 973-835-0143).
